project: Wuxia Life P22 Content Library Expansion And Live Ops Baseline
description: Expand the wuxia content library through a bounded live-ops baseline pass by auditing weak pools, defining baseline coverage rules, adding explicit coverage reporting surfaces, shipping representative early, mid, and late content-wave samples with matching tuning samples, and proving via validation artifacts that future experience gains can come mainly from content-library growth and configuration tuning without UI work, new themes, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit early-life content-library coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of origin, childhood shaping, and early route-divergence pools so that P22 targets the highest-value early-life holes first.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current origin, childhood shaping, and early route-divergence content pools
Mark each audited pool as strong, weak, sparse, or repetitive
Record the main early-life player-experience risks caused by thin or repetitive coverage
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit mid-life consequence coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of relationship, faction, and social-role continuation pools so that P22 can prioritize the weakest mid-life consequence surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current relationship consequence, faction consequence, and social-role continuation content pools
Mark each audited pool as strong, weak, sparse, or repetitive
Record the main mid-life player-experience risks caused by weak route differentiation or weak sustained-role support
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit legacy and endgame coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of legacy, disciple or heir, endgame, and historical-memory pools so that P22 can target thin late-life closure surfaces instead of expanding blindly.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current legacy, disciple or heir outcome, endgame closure, and historical-memory content pools
Mark each audited pool as strong, weak, sparse, or repetitive
Record the main late-life player-experience risks caused by weak closure, weak legacy continuity, or weak historical-memory differentiation
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write P22 expansion prioritization rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit prioritization rules for content-library expansion so that future waves fill high-value holes before decorative growth.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how P22 prioritizes high-value gaps versus nice-to-have thematic expansion
Define what counts as acceptable pool redundancy versus harmful thinness or duplication

Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Define representative baseline pool sets
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit baseline pool sets so that future live-ops waves target stable foundations rather than implicit expectations.

Do not require runtime redesign in this story

userStories.title: Write live-ops baseline scope and deferral rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit live-ops baseline rules so that P22 proves a sustainable operating model without overreaching into unrelated feature work.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the target baseline content pools and wave scope that P22 must prove in practice
